faq3.title: Frequently asked questions
faq3.description: What to expect when you work with Sollari.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: E-commerce apps, company and portfolio websites, mobile apps for Android and iOS, and custom web platforms such as dashboards, booking systems and internal tools.
Flutter and Kotlin Multiplatform for mobile, Next.js, React and Astro for the web, and Rust or Django on the backend. We choose per project based on what it needs.

items.q: How much does a company website cost?
items.a: NPR 4,000 per year plus the cost of your domain. That covers building the site to your needs and deploying and hosting it. E-commerce, mobile and custom software are priced per project after we agree the scope.

items.q: Can you host and maintain the product after launch?
items.a: Yes. We can host your site or app on our own infrastructure, monitor it and keep it updated, or hand it over to your team with documentation.
Send us a short description of your project using the form below. We will reply to discuss scope, timeline and the best way to build it.
